name: Skeleton Finger
summary: A severed, bony digit scavenged from the walking dead prowling the cursed groves and cemeteries of Duskwood. Madame Eva of Darkshire collects these macabre remnants alongside ghoul fangs and spider venom to craft protective talismans.

sections.title: Bones of the Restless
sections.body: The cursed woods of Duskwood are overrun by the restless remains of the dead, ranging from skeletal raiders and warriors to necrotic mages and fiends. While ordinary travelers avoid touching the foul remains of the risen dead, fortune tellers and mystics value their cold essence. Madame Eva, the resident seer of Darkshire, gathers these bony fingers to bind their lingering necrotic energies into a ward of retaliatory magic known as the Totem of Infliction.

faq.q: What creatures drop a Skeleton Finger?
faq.answer: Skeleton Fingers are harvested from the various skeletal undead found across Duskwood, including Skeletal Raiders, Healers, Warders, Warriors, Horrors, Fiends, and Skeletal Mages.

faq.q: Who wants Skeleton Fingers in Duskwood?
faq.answer: Madame Eva, the diviner residing in Darkshire, requires them as part of the ritual components needed to enchant a protective ward.

faq.q: What is the Totem of Infliction?
faq.answer: It is an enchanted ward crafted by Madame Eva using skeleton fingers, ghoul fangs, and spider venom. She weaves their dark energies into an aura designed to inflict retaliatory harm upon anyone who attempts violence against the bearer.

faq.q: Why does Madame Eva need undead remains for a protective charm?
faq.answer: Madame Eva's rituals channel the latent taint and aggression residing in the local monsters. By binding the violent essences of Duskwood's skeletons, ghouls, and venomous beasts together, she turns their own lingering malice into a ward that punishes hostile attackers.

angles.text: Mages studying folk divination will find Madame Eva's method of turning skeletal digits and natural venoms into a retaliatory enchantment an unusual blend of hedge witchcraft and sympathetic magic.
Paladins may shudder at desecrating skeletal remains and carrying their severed parts, yet in the dire gloom of Duskwood, repurposing the bones of the unholy to shield the living is a grim necessity.
